gear_rating_primary.Tr_condition: allowable continuous gear load at input2000rpm per p13; not installed motor thermal or complete joint rating

torque_reference_scope: CSG gear catalogue Tr/Tav condition, not full joint continuous/peak/payload rating
warnings: Historical upper load still contains incompatible old structure; adding new candidate descendant material is a retained-context challenge, not actual new robot net mass.
Own OEM packaging mass owner split is not true fixed/input/output mass allocation.
Native finite section is measured; beam/compression formulas omit fastener preload, contact, bolt holes near interfaces, buckling imperfections, fatigue and local prying.
Roll carrier post-clearance slices retain exact steel/Al geometry; separate material sections and connections must be judged together, not assume cleared Al section alone takes all load.
6082 properties apply only explicit unwelded eligible stock hypothesis, not cast/welded/overheated material.
No thermal/voltage/regeneration architecture or complete axis solver proven.
Gear Tav/Tr are distinct; exceeding Tr alone is not an absolute drive failure, and staying below it does not prove continuous operation.
